traits.stem_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (read on eFloras 2026-10-19), : Astrophytum asterias: plants flat-topped and usually flush with the soil surface, or at most the above-ground portion a low dome; stems shiny, sparsely speckled by bright white extra-areolar hair tufts 0.5-1 mm across; ribs usually 8, straight, very low, nearly flat or rounded; areoles 3-5 mm across, with yellow or gray wool. Flowers opening widely, externally long woolly; inner tepals lanceolate, acuminate. Flowering Mar-May and sporadically after summer rain.

traits.stem_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (read on eFloras 2026-10-19), : Astrophytum: stem unsegmented, dark green or gray-green, hemispheric or depressed-spheric, (2.5-)6-15 × 6-10(-20) cm, speckled by numerous tufts of dense, whitish hairs less than 0.5 mm; ribs 8-10, broad and nearly flat or rounded; areoles 6-9 mm apart, circular; spines absent. Flowers near the stem apex, funnelform; ovary sparsely to densely scaly, the axils long hairy with arachnoid trichomes. Fruits sparsely to densely scaly, the axils of the scales long woolly, spineless; floral remnant persistent. Stems of A. asterias shiny green (the species' note: 'hard, speckled, almost shiny, green stem surface'); a dull mid green by hand.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (read on eFloras 2026-10-19), : Astrophytum: flowers funnelform, 4.5-5.4 × 3.8-5.2 cm; inner tepals yellow, proximally red, 25 × 6-10 mm; stigma lobes 10-12, yellow. Fruits green or pinkish to red, ovoid to spheric, 15-20 × 12 mm. The carpels are as many as the stigma lobes; colours by hand from the words, the red reaching about a third of the tepal.

traits.stem_buried.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (read on eFloras 2026-10-19), Astrophytum asterias: plants flat-topped and usually flush with soil surface, or at most, above-ground portion low, dome-shaped. Until round 5 the stem was sunk by hand only 1.5 cm of its 6, so it stood as a drum; the family's rule now sinks it so only its top and dome show.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (read on eFloras 2026-10-19), : Astrophytum asterias: plants flat-topped and usually flush with the soil surface, or at most the above-ground portion a low dome; stems shiny, sparsely speckled by bright white extra-areolar hair tufts 0.5-1 mm across; ribs usually 8, straight, very low, nearly flat or rounded; areoles 3-5 mm across, with yellow or gray wool. Its height is the stem's, (2.5-)6-15 cm in the genus, most of it below ground: only 1 to 4 cm stands above it.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from the flora's words: one flat-topped stem sunk to its rim in the soil, a few yellow flowers at its centre in spring. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: A rough stem height, most of it below ground: about 7 cm by 15 years. Wide tolerance.

appearance.note: Rib depth and sharpness by eye for the flora's 'very low, nearly flat or rounded' ribs; the felt and flecks' size from its areoles 3-5 mm and tufts 0.5-1 mm.
